propertySets.name: Pset_PointMachine
propertySets.definition: Properties of point machine used in railway. The property set can be used by IfcActuator with predefined type set to ELECTRICACTUATOR, HYDRAULICACTUATOR, HANDOPERATEDACTUATOR, or PNEUMATICACTUATOR, indicated that such actuator is a point machine that can switch and lock the track turnout.

properties.name: ActionBarMovementLength
properties.definition: The movement of the bar that pulls the point of a turnout.

properties.name: TractionForce
properties.definition: Traction force of the point machine in turnout conversion.

properties.name: LockingForce
properties.definition: Locking force of the point machine motor.

properties.name: HasLockInside
properties.definition: Indicates whether the locking is inside  (TRUE) or outside (FALSE) of the point machine.

properties.name: MarkingRodMovementLength
properties.definition: The length of the movement bar which indicates the turnout position.

properties.name: MaximumOperatingTime
properties.definition: The maximum duration of the turnout movement before the interlocking turns to out of control status.

properties.name: MinimumOperatingSpeed
properties.definition: Minimum operating speed of the point machine.

properties.name: Current
properties.definition: The actual current and operable range.
